name: Elf off the Shelf
desc:
🎄 Tiny elves. BIG trouble! 
Jump off the shelf, prank the House and don't get caught!

Become a mischievous toy elf and turn the family home into Christmas chaos! Sneak around, pull hilarious pranks, and work with your friends to fill the Naughty Bar before sunrise.

👀 Stay out of sight the family is watching!
🧸 Flop and pretend you’re an innocent toy.
🧻 Pull sneaky pranks and leave a mess behind.
🚀 Get caught and go flying out of the house!
🪙 Earn Coal Coins and unlock outfits, hats, emotes, and launch effects.
🤝 Team up with friends for even more mischief!

Can you cause enough chaos before morning?

llm.loop: play as a toy elf -> sneak around the house pulling pranks -> freeze/flop when the family looks -> fill the Naughty Bar before sunrise -> earn Coal Coins for cosmetics
llm.objectives: as a team, fill the Naughty Bar with pranks before sunrise without getting caught
llm.progression: Coal Coins for outfits, hats, emotes and launch effects
llm.instructions: jump off the shelf, prank the house, stay out of sight, flop to pretend you are a toy; getting caught launches you out of the house
unique: co-op stealth prank game as Elf on the Shelf with freeze-when-watched rule
llm.thumbnails: cartoon elves sneaking with toilet paper, sleeping dad with clown nose pranked by elves, FREEZE! and RAGDOLL TO HIDE text
llm.complexity_notes: detailed house map, npc family detection ai, multiple prank interactions, ragdoll hiding
